title: Conveyancing Paralegal/Assistant
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
Our client is seeking a Conveyancing Paralegal to join their property department on the outskirts of Cambridge, Cambridgeshire. You will be needed to assist Fee Earner's in the performance of his/her role in the Property Department.

The practice is looking for an individual with drive and ambition, who can work on their own initiative as well as in a team, take ownership and manage their own casework, with an emphasis on excellent written and verbal communication.

Responsibilities:
- Typing correspondence and documents including faxes and e mails.
- Managing own casework
- Preparing and distributing papers documents for meetings
- Liaise with courts and legal professionals
- Drafting letters and other documents

Other Duties that you will be expected to carry out include:
- Dealing promptly with all correspondence/instructions
- Dealing promptly with all telephone/faxes and emails
- Organizing meetings with other fee earners and clients as necessary or directed
- Booking Meeting Rooms
- Keeping departmental and individual diaries up to date
- Ensuring that post, document exchange and hand deliveries are sent promptly

Requirements:
- 6+ months experience as a Conveyancing Paralegal
- Experience in Property Law is essential
- Discretion, for dealing with confidential information
- Computer literacy
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail
- Exceptionally high standard of spelling and grammar
- The ability to work to deadlines and multitaskptly
- Ensuring that Photocopying is delivered to the General Office

Other Duties:

You are also expected to carry out any reasonable additional duties as may be requested to assist in the smooth running of the Department or in support of the designated Fee Earner or Fee Earners.

Should you have any questions or wish to apply please do not hesitate to contact Clear IT Recruitment Limited.

Please Note: Due to the number of applications we receive we may be unable to respond to every application directly. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

title: Legal Secretary - Excellent Benefits & Environment
description:
Legal Secretary required with a Private Client/Family Law background ideally, applications welcomed with any legal background. The position is a traditional office-based role with fantastic access to public transport. The role will be working in the Private Client team to provide professional, pro-active, high level secretarial support on a broad range of issues relating to estates and private property, tax planning and family matters. You will work with an allocated fee earner or group of fee earners as well as supporting the wider fee earning team.

The team covers:
- Will drafting
- Succession planning
- Tax efficient lifetime giving
- Disputed Wills
- Creation administration and termination of trusts
- Advice to trustees and beneficiaries
- Trust Taxation
- Offshore trusts

Manage diaries of allocated fee earners in Microsoft Outlook to include:
- Making appointments
- Arranging meetings/conferences
Sending and responding to invites
- Process expense claims, payment requisition forms, returned advances
- To accurately maintain and update client and other relevant contact details on our client database
- To process all forms including new client form, new matter form, money laundering form, training course booking forms etc.

Our client appreciates the people who work for them, and their rewards package is reviewed regularly to reflect that. You can expect to receive:

25 days holiday (FTE) plus Bank Holidays

Long Service holiday award - 1 extra week every 10 years continuous service
Agile Working Policy
Scottish Widows Pension Scheme (5% employer / 5% Employee)
Staff Profit Share / Salary sacrifice (Pensions, Staff Profit Share)
Paid CSR day
Enhanced Maternity/Paternity Leave
Season Ticket Loan
Subsidised gym membership
Eye Care Voucher
Private Healthcare - BUPA
Life Assurance - 4 x salary / Permanent Health Insurance
Dress for your Day Policy
Discounted legal services.

For more information, please apply with a current CV, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.
